advisory_text: Namaste Savita Patil. Your FarmCredit risk level is Medium. Main pressure points: Existing debt increased pressure on repayment capacity; Loan size is high relative to what similar farms typically carry; Weaker repayment history increased risk. What is helping: Farm income provides a stronger buffer for repayment. Next steps: match crop and irrigation to local rainfall, keep loan size close to expected income, and ask your bank/CSC about KCC, PM-KISAN, and PMFBY eligibility. Figures here are indicative for this demo — confirm locally.
